usage_logger.title: See usage without saving prompts
usage_logger.description: Write one content-free JSONL record for each completed response: provider, model, status, latency and reported token counts.

tool_governor.title: Choose the tools your model sees
tool_governor.description: Restrict or replace model-visible tool definitions. For example, expose search and read tools while omitting deployment tools during a review.

otel.title: Add request metrics
otel.description: Emit request shape, latency, observed status classes and provider-reported token usage through Torana's metrics host.

schema_translator.title: Adapt map-shaped tool schemas
schema_translator.description: Convert supported open-map tool parameters into key/value arrays for providers that need a constrained schema, then reverse the recorded conversion on streamed tool calls.

intent.title: Carry the reason for a tool call
intent.description: Ask the model to include why it is making a tool call, strip the added field before the harness sees the streamed call, and make captured intent available to a compactor.

keyword_compactor.title: Trim repeatable tool output without another model
keyword_compactor.description: Apply explicit deterministic or keyword policies to selected tool results. Useful for long searches and listings that can be rerun, while keeping source reads exact.

compactor.title: Summarize selected historical tool results
compactor.description: Use an operator-bound model for eligible older tool output, only when the estimated benefit clears the cache-rewrite and summarizer-cost gate.

pii.title: Check tool output before forwarding it
pii.description: Scan selected tool results with deterministic patterns and an operator-bound contextual model. Block the request when a finding is detected.

cache_tier_selector.title: Choose a cache lifetime for a conversation
cache_tier_selector.description: Choose between configured prompt-cache tiers using observed idle gaps, while keeping a live cached prefix's choice stable.

cache_warmer.title: Keep one conversation's cache warm for a bounded gap
cache_warmer.description: Opt a conversation into periodic refresh requests, with a deadline and break-even budget. Useful only for explicit cache markers whose lifetime refreshes on a read.
